title: Run output must include a per-phase token and cost breakdown
description: There is no visibility into how tokens are distributed across the phases of a run (spec authoring, run execution, review, rubric verification). Without this data it is impossible to identify which phase dominates cost, optimise prompt sizes, or give a QA agent the information it needs to assess efficiency. The start_spec prompt alone is known to be 144K characters — but the total session cost is unknown.
proposed_resolution: Instrument each major phase of a run (start_spec, start_run, complete_review, verify_rubrics, query_agent calls) to record input_tokens, output_tokens, and estimated_cost_usd at phase exit, using token counts from the adapter response. Write the per-phase breakdown into the run file metrics section as a phases array. Print a summary table to stdout on run completion showing phase name, tokens in, tokens out, and estimated cost. The summary must also show the cumulative total.
